trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Verified the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate and failing health checks.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: Reviewing the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, and only in staging, so it was excluded).

3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all production regions. Verified the service has recovered — it's now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause investigation of v2.3.1 (which was also unhealthy in staging as v2.3.1-rc) remains open.
